name: Apply for Work From Home
goal: User applies for work from home for a specific date in Hinglish.
constraints: Bot should process WFH request and confirm.

phases.description: User says '15 July ko work from home chahiye, doctor appointment hai'.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot summarizes WFH request and asks for confirmation.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
